controls.play_animation_hint: Plays this demonstration's animation, with the camera swaying slowly as in the video; the sliders follow it. Moving one of its sliders stops it.
controls.reset_parameters_hint: Every slider back to this demonstration's start. The camera stays; R resets it too.
controls.steps_hint: Light the lines of one step.
controls.camera_hint: The CameraData record of this view. Dragging in the view orbits; right-dragging pans.
controls.listing_hint: Python pseudo-code of the {engine} function named in the panel.
controls.narration_hint: The narration's volume, as on the Config page; it is kept when you leave the viewer.
controls.speed_hint: How fast the timeline plays, its narration too (at its own pitch).
home.applied_for_session: Applied for this session: there is no configuration directory.
home.subtitle: Illustrated investigations of game-engine features
home.choose: Choose an engine and a feature to investigate
home.no_narration: No narration track yet: it plays silently.
home.esc_hint: In the viewer, Esc returns here. Esc here returns to the title. F11: screenshot.
home.full_screen_hint: Open the homepage and the viewer in borderless full screen.
home.defaults_shown: The defaults are shown; Save and Apply to use them.
home.no_config_dir: No configuration directory: settings last for this session.
home.esc_discards: Esc discards the changes and returns to the title.
home.countdown: The previous settings come back in {seconds} s.
home.language_hint: The homepage's language, and the narrated edition it offers first (English when a feature has none in this language).
home.audio_hint: The homepage's music, and a narrated video's voice. The viewer's dock also sets the narration's volume.
home.listing_style_hint: How the viewer's Code tab draws pseudo-code: as blocks, with loops and branches wrapped around their bodies and each line coloured by what it does (control, memory read, memory write, maths), or as indented Python text.
home.theme_hint: The colours of the homepage and the viewer. A theme is a TOML file in one of these folders; a file in the later one takes the place of one of the same name in the earlier:
home.render_hint: A change to the render settings is tried for ten seconds before it is kept; the others apply when they are saved.
home.pse_message: A very small number of people may have a seizure when exposed to certain visual images, including flashing lights, flickering, moving patterns, and quick changes of brightness, which this program's demonstrations and videos can show. Even people with no history of seizures or epilepsy may have an undiagnosed condition. If you or anyone in your family has had seizures or epilepsy, consult a doctor before using this program. Stop at once and consult a doctor if you feel dizzy, or have altered vision, eye or muscle twitching, loss of awareness, disorientation, any involuntary movement, or convulsions.
ui.no_caption: No subtitle yet at this point of the timeline.
ui.notice_terms: Its terms: {file}, which comes with the package and with this video (NOTICE.txt).
viewer.paused_hint: paused: orbit, pick, and use the sliders
viewer.drag_hint: drag orbit · right-drag pan · wheel zoom · click pick
viewer.diagram_hint: scroll to zoom ({zoom}x) · drag to pan · double-click to fit
controls.free_camera_hint: Look at the scene from a second camera (C). Drag, pan and scroll move it; the demonstration keeps following the main camera, drawn with its view cone.
experiments.experiment_hint: Every value of this investigation, whichever demonstration is open. Changed values are marked and carry over to the next demonstration in experiments mode.
experiments.compare_hint: Set the current values as the reference (A), change values, and compare the live image (B) with it. Both views keep their own history.
experiments.set_reference_hint: The current values become A; the camera stays shared.
experiments.measure_hint: Reads both images back and computes PSNR, SSIM, ꟻLIP, MSE, and relative MSE (scene only, without overlays).
experiments.measure_needs_reference: Set a reference first: the measurement compares B with A.
experiments.reference_set: Reference set: change values to compare.
experiments.performance_hint: GPU time per pass from timestamp queries, over the last frames, and the viewer's frame time.
experiments.no_timestamps: No GPU timestamps on this device: frame time only.
experiments.presets_hint: Save the current values (and the reference) as an experiment file; the command line runs the same file as a research experiment.
experiments.save_hint: Writes an experiment file among your experiments.
experiments.load_hint: Open its demonstration, camera, values, and reference.
experiments.engine_settings_hint: The engine's own settings the port honours, grouped by what they belong to; hover a name for the property it mirrors.
experiments.scene_hint: The scene's values: lights, materials, objects.
experiments.presentation_hint: What the demonstrations draw over the scene: overlays, steps, worked examples.
ui.resize_hint: Drag to resize · double-click for the default size
controls.reset_layout_hint: The panel, the code panel, and this dock back to their default sizes (and saved).
graph.title: Frame graph
graph.summary: {nodes} passes, {resources} resources, in the order they run
graph.hint: ■ writes, ○ reads; a line is a resource's lifetime. Click a mark to see the resource right after that pass.
graph.about_depth_views: Draws the depth views an investigation declares, such as shadow maps and cube faces, one layer at a time. It runs only when what they see has changed.
graph.about_scene: Draws the scene's meshes with the lab's own lighting into the hdr image, in linear light before tone mapping.
graph.about_overlay: Draws the lab's lines, boxes and points on top of the scene, tested against the scene's depth so they hide behind nearer surfaces.
graph.about_composite: Tone-maps the hdr image to display colours, draws the overlay over it, and writes the frame that is shown on screen.
graph.passes_hint: Every pass of the frame in the order it runs. Click one to select it: its card is called out and its result shows in the inspector.
graph.pick_hint: Hover or click a pass in the panel, or pick one below, to read what it does.
graph.resources_hint: Every resource as the frame leaves it. Drag to move; double-click to reset; click a card to inspect it.
graph.source_pick: Click a pass to see the WGSL it is compiled from.
graph.source_module: Compiled from {module} as it is now · {entries} and what they use
graph.reload_failed:
A shader edit does not compile; the last good pipelines keep running:
{error}
graph.dag_hint: Each card is a pass and its result right after it; arrows carry what it writes to what reads it. Drag the view or a card to move it; double-click to reset; click a card to inspect.
perf.title: Performance
perf.history: The last {frames} frames: GPU time (accent), frame time (faint)
perf.no_timestamps: This GPU has no timestamp queries: frame times only.
experiments.show_graph_hint: The Frame graph tab: the frame as a DAG of passes holding their results (or as a grid, or its resources), and what each pass does. A story shows it with panel=dag, panel=graph or panel=resources, and a resource with imageGraph=<pass>.<resource>.
experiments.show_panel_hint: The performance panel on the right: GPU time per pass and its history. A story shows it with panel=performance and calls out passes with highlight.

topic.gpu.title: GPU parallel execution
topic.gpu.summary: Invocations running one program in lockstep groups (subgroups, warps, wavefronts), workgroups, hiding memory latency by switching groups, branch divergence, throughput over latency
topic.cg.title: Radiometry
topic.cg.summary: Solid angle and projected solid angle; flux, intensity, irradiance, exitance and radiance; radiance constant along a ray; the inverse-square law
topic.rt.title: The graphics pipeline
topic.rt.summary: Vertex processing, triangle setup and rasterization, pixel coverage, perspective-correct attribute interpolation, the programmable stages around them
topic.gpu-queues.title: Queues and command submission
topic.gpu-queues.summary: The device and its queues, recording command buffers and submitting them, the CPU and GPU running asynchronously, reading results back
topic.gpu-resources.title: Buffers, textures, views
topic.gpu-resources.summary: Uniform and storage buffers, 1D/2D/3D/cube textures and arrays, mip levels, views of a resource, bind groups
topic.gpu-formats.title: Texel formats and bit packing
topic.gpu-formats.summary: UNORM/SNORM normalized integers, fixed point, half and full floats, packing several values into one 32-bit word
topic.gpu-hdr-formats.title: HDR packed formats
topic.gpu-hdr-formats.summary: Shared-exponent RGB9E5, R11G11B10 float, RGBA16F; fitting a high dynamic range into few bits with an exponent or a scale
topic.gpu-compute.title: Compute shaders and shared memory
topic.gpu-compute.summary: Dispatching grids of workgroups, invocation and workgroup ids, workgroup (shared) memory, workgroup barriers, storage buffers and textures
topic.gpu-atomics.title: Atomic operations
topic.gpu-atomics.summary: Atomic read-modify-write on shared and global memory, lost-update races, counters, serialization when many invocations hit one address
topic.gpu-scan.title: Reduction, prefix sum, compaction
topic.gpu-scan.summary: Parallel reduction, prefix sum (scan), stream compaction; counting, then offsets from a scan, to build compact lists
topic.gpu-sync.title: Barriers and synchronization
topic.gpu-sync.summary: Execution and memory dependencies, barriers between dispatches and passes, resource state transitions, read-after-write hazards, fences and semaphores
topic.gpu-passes.title: Render passes and targets
topic.gpu-passes.summary: Attachments, render targets and multiple render targets, rendering to a texture, loading and storing attachments, depth-only passes
topic.gpu-frame.title: Frame graphs
topic.gpu-frame.summary: A frame as passes declaring what they read and write; ordering, culling unused passes, transient resources with aliased memory, barriers placed automatically; async compute
topic.gpu-amortize.title: Amortized work and history
topic.gpu-amortize.summary: Updating a share of the work each frame, interleaving, history buffers, ring buffers, exponential moving averages (hysteresis)
topic.rt-spaces.title: Coordinate spaces and projection
topic.rt-spaces.summary: Local, world, view and clip spaces; orthographic and perspective projection and the depth they produce; transforms between spaces, including a light's view
topic.rt-depth.title: The depth buffer
topic.rt-depth.summary: Depth test and write, visibility in any draw order, nonlinear depth from the projection, reversed Z, depth formats
topic.rt-early-z.title: Early-Z and depth pre-pass
topic.rt-early-z.summary: The depth test run before the pixel shader, what disables it (discard, shader depth writes), a depth pre-pass, overdraw
topic.rt-stencil.title: The stencil buffer
topic.rt-stencil.summary: Stencil test and operations, reference value and masks, marking pixels so later passes run only on them
topic.rt-aliasing.title: Sampling and aliasing
topic.rt-aliasing.summary: A pixel as a sample of a signal, aliasing and the Nyquist limit, prefiltering and reconstruction filters, why edges and textures alias
topic.rt-msaa.title: Supersampling and MSAA
topic.rt-msaa.summary: Supersampling versus multisampling: coverage sub-samples shaded once per fragment, centroid sampling, resolve, its cost with many targets
topic.rt-sampling.title: Texture filtering and mipmaps
topic.rt-sampling.summary: Nearest and bilinear magnification, mipmaps and trilinear minification, anisotropic filtering, mip level from screen-space derivatives, texel centres and addressing
topic.rt-cubemaps.title: Cube maps
topic.rt-cubemaps.summary: Six-face textures addressed by a direction, seams between faces, their mips
topic.rt-octahedral.title: Octahedral mapping
topic.rt-octahedral.summary: Mapping the sphere to a square by folding an octahedron: encoding unit vectors (normal packing) and octahedral probe maps
topic.rt-blend.title: Alpha blending and compositing
topic.rt-blend.summary: Alpha blending, the over operator, premultiplied alpha, front-to-back compositing with early exit
topic.rt-color.title: Linear colour and sRGB
topic.rt-color.summary: Colour primaries and the working RGB space, the sRGB transfer function, why shading, blending and mip generation need linear values
topic.rt-tonemapping.title: Exposure and tone mapping
topic.rt-tonemapping.summary: Scene-referred HDR values, exposure (EV100, automatic exposure), tone-mapping curves, display-referred output
topic.rt-normal-maps.title: Normal mapping and tangent space
topic.rt-normal-maps.summary: Tangent frames, normal maps in tangent space, blending normals
topic.rt-reconstruct.title: Position and normal from depth
topic.rt-reconstruct.summary: Inverting the projection to rebuild a pixel's view or world position from depth, and its normal from neighbouring positions
topic.rt-motion-vectors.title: Motion vectors
topic.rt-motion-vectors.summary: Each pixel's screen-space motion from this frame's and last frame's transforms, camera versus object motion, the velocity buffer
topic.rt-gbuffer.title: Forward and deferred shading
topic.rt-gbuffer.summary: Forward versus deferred shading, G-buffer targets and their packing, why MSAA and transparency are awkward when deferred
topic.rt-forward-plus.title: Tiled and clustered shading
topic.rt-forward-plus.summary: Screen tiles or depth-sliced clusters, per-tile depth ranges, each light's bounds tested against each cell, per-cell light lists (Forward+)
topic.rt-fullscreen.title: Screen-space passes
topic.rt-fullscreen.summary: Fullscreen and compute passes over render targets read as textures, one thread per pixel, half-resolution passes
topic.rt-bilateral.title: Bilateral blur and upsampling
topic.rt-bilateral.summary: Blur weighted by depth and normal differences, separable kernels, joint bilateral upsampling of a low-resolution result
topic.rt-depth-raymarch.title: Ray marching the depth buffer
topic.rt-depth-raymarch.summary: A ray stepped through the depth buffer: projecting each step to the screen, comparing depths, a thickness test, refinement, hierarchical (Hi-Z) steps
topic.rt-reprojection.title: Temporal reprojection
topic.rt-reprojection.summary: Following a motion vector to last frame, reading the history there bilinearly, rejecting it where disoccluded or mismatched, blending a running average
topic.rt-taa.title: Temporal anti-aliasing
topic.rt-taa.summary: A sub-pixel jitter of the projection each frame, blended with reprojected history so edges converge; ghosting, flicker, history clamping
topic.rt-upscaling.title: Temporal upscaling
topic.rt-upscaling.summary: Temporal anti-aliasing at a lower render resolution: fewer pixels shaded each frame, jittered, accumulated into a full-resolution image
topic.rt-decals.title: Decals
topic.rt-decals.summary: Box-projected decals: the position rebuilt from depth, tested inside the box, the texture projected and blended into chosen targets
topic.rt-heightfields.title: Heightfields and splatting
topic.rt-heightfields.summary: Heightfield meshes, normals from height differences, blending material layers by splat weights and heights
topic.rt-virtual-texturing.title: Virtual texturing
topic.rt-virtual-texturing.summary: A large texture kept as pages allocated on demand and found through a page table, so only what is needed is resident
topic.rt-hw-ray-tracing.title: Hardware ray tracing
topic.rt-hw-ray-tracing.summary: Ray generation, closest-hit, any-hit and miss shaders, payloads; bottom- and top-level acceleration structures the driver builds, refitted or rebuilt each frame
topic.geo-bounds.title: Bounding volumes and tests
topic.geo-bounds.summary: AABBs, spheres and OBBs; point and overlap tests (sphere-box, box-box); the slab ray-box test with entry and exit distances
topic.geo-tri-box.title: Triangle-box overlap (separating axes)
topic.geo-tri-box.summary: The separating axis theorem; triangle-box overlap on 13 axes: the 3 box normals, the triangle normal, 9 edge cross products
topic.geo-bvh.title: Bounding volume hierarchies
topic.geo-bvh.summary: A tree of bounding volumes over primitives, built top-down by a cost heuristic (SAH); a ray visits only children whose boxes it hits, nearest first; refitting for motion
topic.geo-grids.title: Voxel grids
topic.geo-grids.summary: Dense regular grids of cells (voxels), world-to-cell coordinates, memory growing as the cube of the resolution, 3D textures
topic.geo-octree.title: Sparse voxel octrees
topic.geo-octree.summary: Recursive 2×2×2 subdivision with empty children left out, child index arrays, descending by position bits, level-major layout
topic.geo-clipmaps.title: Clipmaps and cascades
topic.geo-clipmaps.summary: Nested grids of one resolution and growing extent centred on the camera; scrolling by wrap-around addressing; updating only newly exposed slabs
topic.geo-voxelize.title: Voxelization by rasterization
topic.geo-voxelize.summary: Triangles rasterized orthographically along their dominant axis into voxels, conservative coverage, atomic writes into a 3D image, surface versus solid voxelization
topic.geo-sdf.title: Signed distance fields
topic.geo-sdf.summary: Signed and unsigned distance to the nearest surface, the surface as the zero level set, analytic versus sampled fields, trilinear reconstruction, the gradient as the normal
topic.geo-sdf-bricks.title: Sparse distance-field bricks
topic.geo-sdf-bricks.summary: Distances kept only in a narrow band around surfaces: small bricks in a 3D atlas, an index grid pointing to them, empty space in the index, 8-bit values scaled to the band
topic.geo-distance-transform.title: Distance transforms
topic.geo-distance-transform.summary: Turning a surface or seed set into a distance field: brute force, jump flooding (log n propagation passes, approximate), the exact separable Euclidean transform
topic.geo-sphere-tracing.title: Sphere tracing
topic.geo-sphere-tracing.summary: Ray marching that advances by the field's distance value: hits below an epsilon, misses past a limit, step counts, grazing rays
topic.geo-mesh-sdf.title: Per-mesh distance fields
topic.geo-mesh-sdf.summary: A distance field baked once per mesh in its own box, at a resolution set by its size, sampled through each instance's transform with the distance scaled
topic.geo-global-sdf.title: Cascaded scene distance fields
topic.geo-global-sdf.summary: Per-object fields merged by their minimum into one coarse field held in camera-centred cascades, so a ray samples one volume, not every object
topic.cg-visibility.title: Visibility and shadow rays
topic.cg-visibility.summary: The visibility function between two points, shadow rays, the ray-cast function, occlusion as a binary factor of the integrand
topic.cg-photometry.title: Photometry and light units
topic.cg-photometry.summary: Luminous flux in lumens, intensity in candela, illuminance in lux, luminance in nits; the luminous efficiency curve; watts to lumens
topic.cg-lights.title: Punctual lights and falloff
topic.cg-lights.summary: Directional, point and spot lights as a direction or position with an intensity; inverse-square falloff, a windowed cutoff, spot cones and their angular falloff
topic.cg-area-lights.title: Area lights
topic.cg-area-lights.summary: Lights with extent: emitting shapes, soft penumbrae, representative-point approximations, energy normalization of glossy highlights
topic.cg-brdf.title: The BRDF and Lambertian reflection
topic.cg-brdf.summary: The BRDF as outgoing radiance over incoming irradiance, the reflectance equation, reciprocity, energy conservation, directional albedo, Lambertian diffuse
topic.cg-rendering-equation.title: The rendering equation
topic.cg-rendering-equation.summary: Outgoing radiance as emitted plus reflected; incoming radiance as the outgoing radiance of the first surface along the ray; its recursion into bounces
topic.cg-ltc.title: Linearly transformed cosines
topic.cg-ltc.summary: A clamped cosine distribution transformed by a 3×3 matrix to fit a GGX lobe, integrated in closed form over polygonal area lights
topic.cg-fresnel.title: Fresnel reflectance
topic.cg-fresnel.summary: Reflectance rising toward 1 at grazing angles, dielectrics and metals, F0, Schlick's approximation and its limits
topic.cg-microfacet.title: Microfacet theory
topic.cg-microfacet.summary: A surface as a distribution of mirror microfacets; the half vector, the normal distribution D, masking-shadowing G; D·F·G/(4 n·l n·v), Cook-Torrance
topic.cg-ggx.title: GGX and Smith masking-shadowing
topic.cg-ggx.summary: The GGX (Trowbridge-Reitz) distribution and its long tail, height-correlated Smith masking-shadowing, roughness as alpha
topic.cg-anisotropic.title: Anisotropic GGX
topic.cg-anisotropic.summary: Roughness that differs along the tangent and bitangent: two alphas, anisotropic D and Smith terms in a tangent frame
topic.cg-layered.title: Layered materials (clear coat)
topic.cg-layered.summary: A clear-coat layer over a base: the coat's Fresnel attenuating the base, a second specular lobe
topic.cg-burley.title: Burley diffuse
topic.cg-burley.summary: Disney's diffuse model: roughness-dependent retro-reflection at grazing angles, a Fresnel-shaped falloff
topic.cg-pbr-materials.title: Metallic-roughness materials
topic.cg-pbr-materials.summary: Base colour and metalness to diffuse albedo and F0, perceptual roughness squared to alpha, occlusion and emissive channels
topic.cg-specular-aa.title: Specular anti-aliasing
topic.cg-specular-aa.summary: Normals varying within a pixel widen the roughness: filtering normals and normal distributions (Toksvig, LEAN)
topic.cg-mc.title: Monte Carlo integration
topic.cg-mc.summary: Random variables, expectation and probability densities; the estimator as a mean of f/p; bias and consistency; variance and noise falling as 1/√N
topic.cg-importance-sampling.title: Importance sampling
topic.cg-importance-sampling.summary: Sampling with a density shaped like the integrand; the inverse CDF and sampling transformations; cosine-weighted, GGX-lobe and light sampling
topic.cg-sampling-patterns.title: Low-discrepancy and blue-noise samples
topic.cg-sampling-patterns.summary: Stratified samples, Hammersley and Halton sequences, spherical Fibonacci and spiral points, blue-noise masks; lower variance than white noise
topic.cg-brdf-lut.title: Directional albedo tables
topic.cg-brdf-lut.summary: The specular BRDF's directional albedo over n·v and roughness, stored as a scale and bias of F0 in a 2D table (the DFG table)
topic.cg-multiscatter.title: Multiple-scattering compensation
topic.cg-multiscatter.summary: Energy single-scattering microfacets lose at high roughness, an added lobe that restores it, the white-furnace test
topic.cg-sphere-functions.title: Functions on the sphere
topic.cg-sphere-functions.summary: Representing a function of direction: tables, spherical bases (spherical Gaussians, radial basis functions), projection and reconstruction
topic.cg-sh.title: Spherical harmonics
topic.cg-sh.summary: An orthonormal basis on the sphere: bands and coefficients, projection and reconstruction, rotation, convolution, ringing and windowing
topic.cg-irradiance.title: Irradiance and cosine convolution
topic.cg-irradiance.summary: Irradiance as radiance integrated against the cosine over the hemisphere, a function of the normal; why diffuse lighting needs only it
topic.cg-sh-irradiance.title: Irradiance in spherical harmonics
topic.cg-sh-irradiance.summary: The cosine lobe as a low-frequency kernel: nine coefficients per channel reproduce diffuse irradiance, evaluated per normal
topic.cg-environment.title: Environment lighting
topic.cg-environment.summary: Distant lighting that depends only on direction: a sky or captured HDR image stored as a lat-long, cube or octahedral map
topic.cg-prefiltered-env.title: Prefiltered environment maps
topic.cg-prefiltered-env.summary: Specular lobes convolved into mip levels by roughness, a cosine-convolved map for diffuse, the error of assuming a symmetric lobe
topic.cg-gi.title: Global illumination
topic.cg-gi.summary: Light arriving after bouncing off other surfaces, colour bleeding, diffuse versus glossy transport, light paths in L(D|S)*E notation
topic.cg-path-tracing.title: Path tracing
topic.cg-path-tracing.summary: Random paths from the camera one bounce at a time, path throughput, a shadow ray to a light at each vertex, Russian roulette; unbiased but noisy
topic.cg-ao.title: Ambient occlusion
topic.cg-ao.summary: The cosine-weighted fraction of the hemisphere that sees no nearby geometry; obscurance with a distance falloff; interreflection
topic.cg-directional-occlusion.title: Directional and specular occlusion
topic.cg-directional-occlusion.summary: Visibility as a function of direction: bent normals, visibility cones, occlusion weighted by the specular lobe instead of the cosine
topic.cg-sss.title: Subsurface scattering
topic.cg-sss.summary: Light leaving at a different point than it entered (BSSRDF), diffusion profiles, thin-slab translucency versus thick media
topic.cg-hair.title: Hair scattering (R, TT, TRT)
topic.cg-hair.summary: Light scattering from a fibre: Marschner's reflection (R), transmission (TT) and internal-reflection (TRT) lobes
topic.rt-shadow-maps.title: Shadow mapping
topic.rt-shadow-maps.summary: Depth rendered from the light and compared per pixel; depth precision and aliasing, acne, slope-scale and normal-offset bias, peter-panning
topic.rt-csm.title: Cascaded shadow maps
topic.rt-csm.summary: Splitting the view's depth range into cascades, fitting each one's light view, snapping to texels, blending between cascades
topic.rt-shadow-filtering.title: Percentage-closer filtering
topic.rt-shadow-filtering.summary: Comparing several shadow-map texels with the receiver's depth and averaging the results; kernels, rotated samples, hardware bilinear comparison
topic.rt-pcss.title: Contact-hardening soft shadows
topic.rt-pcss.summary: A blocker search in the shadow map, the penumbra width from the light's size and the receiver and blocker depths, then a filter of that width
topic.rt-filterable-shadows.title: Filterable shadow maps (VSM, ESM, MSM)
topic.rt-filterable-shadows.summary: Storing depth moments or exponentials instead of depth so the map can be blurred and mipmapped; a Chebyshev or exponential test; light leaking
topic.rt-omni-shadows.title: Omnidirectional shadow maps
topic.rt-omni-shadows.summary: Six-face cube shadow maps for point lights, seams between faces, spot-light shadow maps packed into an atlas
topic.rt-screen-shadows.title: Screen-space shadow masks
topic.rt-screen-shadows.summary: Resolving shadows into one screen-sized buffer before lighting, then softening it with an edge-aware blur
topic.rt-split-sum.title: Split-sum specular IBL
topic.rt-split-sum.summary: Specular image-based light as a product: a GGX-prefiltered cube read by reflection and roughness, times the directional albedo table
topic.rt-reflection-probes.title: Reflection probes
topic.rt-reflection-probes.summary: Local cube maps captured at points in the scene, box parallax correction of the lookup, blending neighbouring probes
topic.rt-ssr.title: Screen-space reflections
topic.rt-ssr.summary: The reflected ray marched through the depth buffer, the hit's colour read from the lit image, fading at screen edges and with roughness, falling back to probes
topic.rt-ssao.title: Screen-space ambient occlusion
topic.rt-ssao.summary: Samples around each pixel tested against the depth buffer, per-sample weights, rotated sample patterns, an edge-aware blur
topic.rt-ssil.title: Screen-space indirect light
topic.rt-ssil.summary: Gathering the lit colour of nearby pixels as one bounce of diffuse light; nothing from off screen, view-dependent, denoised
topic.rt-screen-sss.title: Screen-space subsurface scattering
topic.rt-screen-sss.summary: Diffuse light blurred in screen space by a separable kernel shaped by the diffusion profile and scaled by depth
topic.rt-shadow-thickness.title: Thickness from shadow maps
topic.rt-shadow-thickness.summary: The distance light travels inside an object, from the difference between the shadow map's depth and the surface's, for transmission
topic.rt-virtual-shadow-maps.title: Virtual shadow maps
topic.rt-virtual-shadow-maps.summary: Very large shadow maps stored as pages, rendered only where the view needs them and cached between frames
topic.rt-shadow-ray-marching.title: Soft shadows by marching shadow maps
topic.rt-shadow-ray-marching.summary: Rays toward points of an area light marched through a shadow map's depths and averaged into a soft penumbra
topic.gi-probes.title: Irradiance volumes (probe grids)
topic.gi-probes.summary: Irradiance sampled at the points of a grid and interpolated trilinearly for diffuse light; static or updated probes, normal bias, facing weights
topic.gi-probe-maps.title: Probe encodings (SH, octahedral)
topic.gi-probe-maps.summary: One spherical function per probe: a few SH coefficients, or an octahedral map with duplicated border texels for bilinear filtering
topic.gi-probe-visibility.title: Probe visibility and leaks
topic.gi-probe-visibility.summary: Why interpolating probes across walls leaks light and darkness; backface weights, normal bias, occlusion tests that zero a probe's weight
topic.gi-probe-depth.title: Probe distance moments
topic.gi-probe-depth.summary: Per-direction mean and mean squared distance stored beside each probe's irradiance; a Chebyshev bound turns them into a visibility weight
topic.gi-probe-tracing.title: Probe rays and blending
topic.gi-probe-tracing.summary: A fixed number of rays per probe each frame in a rotating pattern; hits shaded, misses read the sky; results blended into the probe's texels with hysteresis
topic.gi-voxel-light.title: Voxel light injection
topic.gi-voxel-light.summary: Direct light evaluated per voxel with shadow-map visibility, outgoing radiance stored per face direction, in an HDR format
topic.gi-voxel-mips.title: Prefiltered voxel mips
topic.gi-voxel-mips.summary: Coarser levels averaging eight children weighted by opacity, anisotropic voxels keeping six directional values, aggregation up an octree
topic.gi-cone-tracing.title: Voxel cone tracing
topic.gi-cone-tracing.summary: One cone instead of many rays: stepping along its axis, reading the mip whose voxel matches its width, compositing front to back; several cones for diffuse, one for glossy
topic.gi-sdf-tracing.title: Tracing cascaded distance fields
topic.gi-sdf-tracing.summary: Sphere tracing through the cascade that holds the ray, handing it to the next coarser cascade when it leaves
topic.gi-multibounce.title: Multi-bounce by feedback
topic.gi-multibounce.summary: Reading last frame's indirect light at each hit, so each frame adds a bounce; a series bounded by the albedo; lag
topic.gi-surface-cache.title: Surface caches in atlases
topic.gi-surface-cache.summary: Surfaces captured by small orthographic projections into atlas pages (albedo, normal, emissive, depth, lighting); a ray's hit reads its texel there instead of shading the mesh
topic.gi-radiosity.title: Radiosity by gathering
topic.gi-radiosity.summary: Each cached surface element gathering the lighting its surroundings held at the last update, so each update adds a bounce; stored as spherical harmonics
topic.gi-screen-probes.title: Screen-space probe gather
topic.gi-screen-probes.summary: Probes placed on the depth buffer every few pixels, each tracing an octahedral set of rays, filtered with neighbours and history, interpolated per pixel by depth and normal
topic.gi-radiance-cache.title: Radiance caches
topic.gi-radiance-cache.summary: Probes in clipmapped grids around the camera storing incoming radiance, not irradiance, so long rays stop early and read the far lighting there
topic.gi-glossy-tracing.title: Traced glossy reflections
topic.gi-glossy-tracing.summary: A GGX-importance-sampled ray per pixel for smooth surfaces, in screen space first and then in the scene, denoised; rough surfaces fall back to diffuse probes
